execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a future MSWI tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries that tranche through implementation, required validation, verified closeout, and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, history, and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation, and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If the selected tranche cannot credibly leave the closeout reserve intact, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the tranche.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MSWI is a systemic-worldplay integration family; it does not become a second World, Environment, Character, Creature, Vehicle, Base, Project, Economy, Organization, Religion, Culture, Action/Event or content-definition ledger

DPL-01..14 remain completed_verified and authoritative for profession activity profiles, enterprise/staffing/growth, arts/performance, cybernetics/symbiotes/biotech and life-simulation foundations; MSWI composes them into cross-system worldplay rather than reopening DPL

MNCS retains NPC/creature generation, ecology/habitat/lifecycle/population-generation and ecology-change authoring boundaries; MSWI consumes accepted ecology/population state and routes systemic consequences without creating a second creature simulator
GPR retains reusable gameplay-pattern execution and loop-composition semantics; MSWI defines cross-domain systemic compositions and diagnostics over GPR rather than a competing gameplay runtime

MERA retains engineering/refit/assembly authority and MBES retains built-environment, infrastructure, utilities, logistics, production, settlement and reactive-development hooks; MSWI consumes their accepted outputs for persistent world consequences

MSLR retains non-standard spatial-law runtime authority including dynamic topology, metric geometry, fuzzy boundaries, spatial-law discovery, anchors/counterplay and impossible-space execution; MSWI consumes MSLR spatial events and deltas rather than creating a second spatial runtime
MCS retains map/cartographic geometry authority, MAS retains Adventure/Scene assembly authority, MCCS retains entity presentation authority and MSAS retains audio authoring/playback authority
persistent world transformation always records source, scope, timing, reversibility, affected owner domains and provenance; a visible presentation change is not itself canonical world mutation

ecology runtime uses bounded population bands, suitability, migration and event-driven succession unless an owner profile explicitly supplies finer detail; MSWI does not require per-individual biological simulation

composite entities preserve one stable identity while binding multiple governed roles such as creature, mount, vehicle, base host, NPC or location host; role binding never duplicates ownership or canonical state
creature anatomy and harvest mechanics use source-authored or accepted component definitions; absent anatomy, organ, yield or damage facts remain unresolved rather than invented

grafts, implants, symbiotes and other embodied modifications preserve donor/source lineage, compatibility, grants, removals, retained state and reversal behavior; identity, memory or psychological consequences require explicit governed rules/content

doctrine and ideology progression is live Campaign/organization state layered over reusable Religion/Culture/Organization definitions; belief choices may create obligations and consequences but do not rewrite reusable source definitions
profession, enterprise and downtime orchestration consumes DPL/Project/Economy/Base/Organization owners and does not create a parallel business or calendar ledger
pursuit/race/chase runtime is vehicle-, mount-, foot-, air-, water- and space-capable through shared patterns and does not hard-code one transport mode
diegetic audio, lyric, rhythm, ritual or performance cues always expose accessible non-audio equivalents and cannot make protected music/assets a runtime dependency
grand/world projects aggregate governed contributions and consequences through Project, faction, economy, crafting, settlement and world owners rather than silently mutating those domains

procedural site/scenario remix is deterministic from accepted templates/components/seed where declared; generated output is ephemeral or proposed until GM/owner-authorized promotion creates persistent Campaign state
environment-state map/scene variants preserve stable location identity and provenance across historical/current/alternate projections

interaction-density diagnostics measure declared cross-system responsiveness, effect fan-out, loops, dead integrations and missing consequence routes; the metric cannot invent mechanics merely to increase a score

optional AI may recommend compositions, consequences, missing links and tests but cannot silently mutate world state, accept generated sites, change doctrine, apply grafts, harvest creatures or commit projects

proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected code, formulas, authored content, UI expression, assets, music, maps, save formats and private protocols are not copied
no paid/cloud provider is required for blocking MSWI workflows
no MSWI implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific MSWI work item
